entity.name: Infosys Limited
entity.security: Fully paid-up Equity Shares of face value INR 5 each
entity.ads_note: Corresponding 1:1 stock dividend on American Depositary Shares (NYSE: INFY; 1 ADS = 1 equity share). ADSs are not an admitted security in this repository and are not transcribed.

event.terms: 1 new fully paid-up bonus equity share of INR 5 face value for every 1 existing fully paid-up equity share of INR 5 face value held as of the record date (September 5, 2018). Face value unchanged at INR 5 per share. Bonus shares issued at zero cost to shareholders by capitalizing INR 1,092 crore from retained earnings / free reserves.
event.treasury_note: Controlled trusts holding treasury shares were excluded from receiving bonus shares, though the standard equity share count doubled as shown in the board's capital structure disclosure (operator-supplied note, preserved as stated).

dates.statutory_deadline_note: Credited to shareholders' demat accounts immediately following the record date, ahead of the September 12, 2018 statutory deadline.
